title: SOOPEX: Signals of Opportunity Observation Exchange Format
description: Specification and Python reference implementation for exchanging Doppler observables extracted from non-cooperative LEO satellite signals (Starlink, OneWeb, Iridium, and others). SOOPEX provides, for Signals of Opportunity (SoOp) observables, what RINEX provides for GNSS observables: a human-readable, git-manageable, constellation-agnostic exchange format with YAML header plus TSV data.
